# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.6 R2 phase 1, Georgia. Generated by gen_georgia.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# 2026-11-20 v6.6 R2 phases 2 and 3 (Iviron, the second marriage, the west, Kakheti, the Black Sheep, Florence, the emperor's bride; events 1, 4, 5, 6, 90) added to this file by the same generator.
# 2026-11-20 v6.6 R2 phase 4 (the kingdom divided: the crown of Imereti, Lake Paravani; the line closes on 1467.1.1) added to this file by the same generator.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 25); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): start, void check, close; then the books, the world steps, and at most
# one event in a calm, free month.
oe_geo_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_on } } set_variable = oe_geo_on }
        set_variable = { name = oe_geo_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_void } oe_geo_premise = no }
            set_variable = oe_geo_void
            debug_log = "oe_geo: the line is void"
        }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { current_date >= 1467.1.1 has_variable = oe_geo_void } }
            oe_geo_close = yes
        }
        else = {
            # phase 4: the Byzantine events end where the line used to close (1454.1.1); the world steps go on
            if = { limit = { current_date >= 1454.1.1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_ev_off } } oe_geo_close_events = yes }
            oe_geo_books = yes
            oe_geo_world = yes
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_ev_off } } oe_geo_events = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The line closes: a tribute it made and that still stands is cancelled, the events that have not come are
# given up. What already happened stays on record (the chronicle row looks at oe_geo_none).
oe_geo_close = {
    oe_geo_release = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_5 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_6 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_6 value = 2 } }
    set_variable = oe_geo_off
    debug_log = "oe_geo: the line is closed"
}
# BYZ scope. Phase 4: from 1454.1.1 (the old close) the Byzantine events are over: what the old close did to them is
# done here (a tribute this line made is cancelled, the events that have not come are given up), and no event is
# picked any more (BYZ oe_geo_ev_off). The world steps of phase 4 go on until 1467.1.1.
oe_geo_close_events = {
    oe_geo_release = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_5 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_6 } } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_6 value = 2 } }
    set_variable = oe_geo_ev_off
    debug_log = "oe_geo: the Byzantine events of the line are over"
}

# Any scope. The tribute t1 made is cancelled when it still stands (t2, t6, the close, the reset). A subject relation
# Georgia got in any other way is not touched.
oe_geo_release = {
    if = { limit = { oe_geo_trib_on = yes } c:TIM = { cancel_subject = c:GEO } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_geo_trib global_var:oe_geo_trib = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_trib value = 4 } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The months each event has waited since its world step; the month Timur was first seen in the
# Caucasus (a record for the long runs: design 5.2 item 5).
oe_geo_books = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_geo_wait_6 NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_6 } } change_variable = { name = oe_geo_wait_6 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_geo_wait_3 NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_3 } } change_variable = { name = oe_geo_wait_3 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_geo_wait_2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_st_2 } } change_variable = { name = oe_geo_wait_2 add = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_geo_timur_seen } oe_geo_timur_near = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_timur_seen value = var:oe_geo_m }
        debug_log = "oe_geo: Timur is in the Caucasus in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_geo_m').GetValue|0]"
    }
    # phase 2: the west's secession lasts until t5, and ends in any case from 1402.1.1 (design 3.5)
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 1402.1.1 country_exists = c:GEO c:GEO = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_west_secession } }
        c:GEO = { remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_west_secession }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Events: lapse, then at most one while the lock is free (design 3.3): .6 first and without calm
# (design 3.6), the others only in a calm month.
oe_geo_events = {
    if = { limit = { oe_geo_lapse_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_geo_lapse_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_geo_lapse_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_geo_lapse_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_geo_lapse_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_geo_lapse_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ml_free = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_geo_pick value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 0 oe_geo_ok_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_geo_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_geo_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_geo_calm = yes }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 0 oe_geo_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_geo_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_geo_pick value = 3 } } }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 0 oe_geo_ok_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_geo_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_geo_pick value = 5 } } }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 0 oe_geo_ok_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_geo_ch_4 set_variable = { name = oe_geo_pick value = 4 } } }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 0 oe_geo_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_geo_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_geo_pick value = 2 } } }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 0 oe_geo_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_geo_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_geo_pick value = 1 } } }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 6 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_6 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_last value = 6 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_geo.6 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_3 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_last value = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_geo.3 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 5 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_5 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_last value = 5 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_geo.5 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_4 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_last value = 4 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_geo.4 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_last value = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_geo.2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_pick = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_1 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_last value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_geo.1 }
        remove_variable = oe_geo_pick
    }
}

# BYZ scope. A world step runs: its effect, its record (global oe_geo_ws_<s> = 1, oe_geo_at_<s> = the month), the wait of
# the event that follows it.
oe_geo_m1_run = {
    oe_geo_m1_do = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_ws_m1 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_at_m1 value = var:oe_geo_m }
    set_variable = { name = oe_geo_wait_2 value = 0 }
    debug_log = "oe_geo world step m1 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_geo_m').GetValue|0] (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_geo_rd_ws')|0], tribute [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_geo_rd_trib')|0])"
}

oe_geo_t5_run = {
    oe_geo_t5_do = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_ws_t5 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_at_t5 value = var:oe_geo_m }
    debug_log = "oe_geo world step t5 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_geo_m').GetValue|0] (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_geo_rd_ws')|0], tribute [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_geo_rd_trib')|0])"
}

# BYZ scope. m1 the Trebizond marriage (June 1367): Anna, daughter of Alexios III, marries Bagrat V. Only good opinion
# between the two courts: neither is in the 1337 setup, and no character is created.
oe_geo_m1_do = {
    c:GEO = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_geo_bw_trebizond target = c:TRE } }
    c:TRE = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_geo_bw_trebizond target = c:GEO } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_wed value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. t1 the fall of Tbilisi (late November 1386): the city sacked, the king a captive. No war, no land.
oe_geo_t1_do = {
    location:tbilisi = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace } }
    c:GEO = {
        add_prestige = prestige_severe_penalty
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_geo_king_captive months = 24 mode = replace }
    }
    c:TIM = { add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_tbilisi value = 1 }
    # The tribute (design 3.5, 5.1): only when Georgia is nobody's subject. A tributary does not follow its overlord
    # into war. The record is 1 only when the engine really set it.
    if = {
        limit = { c:GEO = { is_subject = no } }
        c:GEO = { make_subject_of = { target = c:TIM type = subject_type:tributary } }
        if = {
            limit = { c:GEO = { is_subject_of = c:TIM } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_trib value = 1 }
            # vanilla's "the demands of Timur" for Georgia: its trigger (a subject of the Timurids of another faith)
            # is checked again when it fires. BYZ variable oe_geo_dev_no24 (a test button) leaves the call out.
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_geo_dev_no24 } } c:GEO = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = flavor_geo.24 days = 30 } } }
        }
        else = {
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_trib value = 2 }
            debug_log = "oe_geo t1: the engine did not make Georgia a tributary of the Timurids"
        }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_trib value = 3 } }
}
# BYZ scope. t2 the king returns (1387): the tribute this line made ends, with a truce; the king is free. Vanilla's
# flavor_geo.26 then restores the faith by itself, if the king converted.
oe_geo_t2_do = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_geo_trib_on = yes }
        oe_geo_release = yes
        c:GEO = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TIM years = 5 mutual = yes } }
    }
    c:GEO = {
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_king_captive } remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_king_captive }
        add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TIM } c:TIM = { add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_king_back value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. t5 the terms of Shamkor (late 1401; the peace of 1403): Georgia pays, Timur lets it be. No subject
# relation. Phase 2: the west's secession ends here (design 3.5).
oe_geo_t5_do = {
    c:GEO = {
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_geo_shamkor_tribute months = 72 mode = replace }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_west_secession } remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_west_secession }
    }
    c:TIM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_geo_bw_shamkor target = c:GEO } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_shamkor value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. t6 after Timur (from February 1405): the payments stop; a tribute t2 never ended is cancelled.
oe_geo_t6_do = {
    c:GEO = {
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_shamkor_tribute } remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_shamkor_tribute }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_king_captive } remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_king_captive }
        add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
    }
    oe_geo_release = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_timur_over value = 1 }
}

# ---- phase 2 world steps

    c:GEO = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_geo_bw_trebizond target = c:TRE } }
    c:TRE = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_geo_bw_trebizond target = c:GEO } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_wed2 value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. t3 the west breaks away (1387): Alexander of Imereti is crowned at Gelati, but Kutaisi stays with the king
# and the western dukes do not follow him. A modifier only; no country is built (design 3.5, 第六节第 6 条).
oe_geo_t3_do = {
    c:GEO = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_geo_west_secession months = 180 mode = replace } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_west value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. t4 the winter of Kakheti (winter 1399): Timur crosses the Kura and falls on Kakheti and Hereti. Georgia's
# own locations there are looted; no land changes hands.
oe_geo_t4_do = {
    province_definition:kakheti_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } } }
    province_definition:hereti_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } } }
    c:GEO = { add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_kakheti value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. k1 Chalagan (1412): the Black Sheep beat Constantine I and his allies. Nobody is killed (the king who

    }
    c:QAR = { add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus }

}
# BYZ scope. k2 Tbilisi at Easter (1440): Jahan Shah takes Samshvilde and sacks Tbilisi. No war, no land.

    location:tbilisi = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } }
    c:GEO = { add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_tbilisi_1440 value = 1 }
}

# ---- phase 4 world steps (the kingdom divided)
# BYZ scope. d1 the crown of Imereti (1463): Bagrat beats George VIII at Chikhori and is crowned king of Imereti. The
# handover of r20 probe 10 (decision 230): IME's cores where missing, then each western home location Georgia holds in
# hand goes to IME, Kutaisi first (the first one wakes the tag, with a ruler). Never Georgia's capital, never a location
# under siege or occupation; nothing of a third country. Self-check (global oe_geo_ime): 1 Imereti stands with two or
# more locations, 5 it exists with fewer, 4 nothing was woken. Only on 1: no overlord, its state before its ruler
# (oe_geo_ime_state), Kutaisi as capital, the king (oe_geo_make_bagrat), a truce of 5 years, Georgia's prestige.
oe_geo_d1_do = {
    location:kutaisi = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:lentekhi = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:skande = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:shorapani = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:tsageri = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:tsesi = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:ushguli = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:vartsikhe = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:bedia = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:anaklia = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:batumi = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:ozurgeti = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:poti_caucasus = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:tsalenjikha = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:sukhumi = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:anacopia = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:lata_georgia = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:pitsunda = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GEO is_capital = no NOT = { is_core_of = c:IME } } add_core = c:IME } }
    location:kutaisi = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:lentekhi = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:skande = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:shorapani = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:tsageri = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:tsesi = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:ushguli = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:vartsikhe = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:bedia = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:anaklia = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:batumi = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:ozurgeti = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:poti_caucasus = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:tsalenjikha = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:sukhumi = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:anacopia = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:lata_georgia = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    location:pitsunda = { if = { limit = { oe_geo_ime_loc = yes is_core_of = c:IME } change_location_owner = c:IME } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_geo_ime_two = yes }
        c:IME = {
            if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } overlord ?= { cancel_subject = c:IME } }
            oe_geo_ime_state = yes
            if = { limit = { location:kutaisi = { owner ?= c:IME is_capital = no } } set_capital = location:kutaisi }
            oe_geo_make_bagrat = yes
            if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:GEO } } add_truce_with = { target = c:GEO years = 5 mutual = yes } }
        }
        c:GEO = { add_prestige = prestige_severe_penalty }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_ime value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:IME } set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_ime value = 5 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_ime value = 4 } }
}
# Country scope (IME). Brief B6/B8: a woken country may take the local pops' culture and faith and keep the old owner's
# court language, and its ruler's title comes out wrong unless the government is set before the ruler. So, before the
# king: a monarchy, the Georgian culture, the Orthodox faith, the Georgian court language (vanilla's IME). Each only
# where it differs (the form of gen_latin_greece.py oe_lgr_west_state).
oe_geo_ime_state = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { government_type = government_type:monarchy } } change_government_type = government_type:monarchy }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { culture = culture:georgian_culture } } change_culture = culture:georgian_culture }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = religion:orthodox } } change_religion = religion:orthodox }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { court_language ?= { this = language:georgian_language } } } set_court_language = culture:georgian_culture.dialect }
}
# Country scope (IME). The king Bagrat (Bagrat VI, born about 1435), the ONE place where he is created (design 3.5:
# only when the ruler the engine gave IME is not a Bagrationi). Created with the named dynasty (r19 probe 4); when that
# leaves nobody, once more without it. Then made ruler and read back (global oe_geo_bagrat: 1 he rules, made with the
# dynasty; 2 without it; 3 made but not ruler; 4 nobody made; 6 the engine's ruler was a Bagrationi and is kept). The
# character is kept in global oe_geo_c_bagrat; nothing else reads him.
oe_geo_make_bagrat = {
    if = {
        limit = { ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes dynasty = dynasty:bagrationi_dynasty } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_bagrat value = 6 }
    }
    else = {
        create_character = {
            first_name = name_bagrat
            female = no
            age = 28
            dynasty = dynasty:bagrationi_dynasty
            culture = culture:georgian_culture
            religion = religion:orthodox
            estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
            save_scope_as = oe_geo_bagrat_s
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_geo_bagrat_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_bagrat value = 1 } }
        else = {
            create_character = {
                first_name = name_bagrat
                female = no
                age = 28
                culture = culture:georgian_culture
                religion = religion:orthodox
                estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                save_scope_as = oe_geo_bagrat_s
            }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_geo_bagrat_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_bagrat value = 2 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_geo_bagrat_s }
            scope:oe_geo_bagrat_s = { set_variable = oe_geo_is_bagrat }
            set_new_ruler = scope:oe_geo_bagrat_s
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_c_bagrat value = scope:oe_geo_bagrat_s }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { ruler ?= { has_variable = oe_geo_is_bagrat } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_bagrat value = 3 } }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_bagrat value = 4 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. d2 Lake Paravani (1465): the atabeg Qvarqvare II takes George VIII captive near Lake Paravani, and
# Samtskhe parts from the kingdom. Georgia lets its subject go (cancel_subject, seen in r19). Self-check (global
# oe_geo_sme_free): 1 Samtskhe is no longer Georgia's subject (then a truce of 5 years and prestige both ways), 4 it
# still is (nothing follows).
oe_geo_d2_do = {
    c:GEO = { cancel_subject = c:SME }
    if = {
        limit = { c:SME = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:GEO } } }
        c:SME = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:GEO } } add_truce_with = { target = c:GEO years = 5 mutual = yes } }
            add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
        }
        c:GEO = { add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_sme_free value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_sme_free value = 4 } }
}

# ---- phase 3: the emperor's bride
# BYZ scope. .6's immediate: pick the bride (brief B6: in the event that fires). She is the eldest
# woman of the partner ruler's dynasty who fits (oe_geo_bride_fit) and lives in the partner country; stored in BYZ
# oe_geo_bride_c. No one fits: the variable stays unset (options b and c).
oe_geo_pick_bride = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_geo_bride_c } remove_variable = oe_geo_bride_c }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_geo_betrothal ?= 1 country_exists = c:GEO }
        c:GEO = {
            ruler ?= {
                dynasty ?= {
                    ordered_character_in_dynasty = {
                        limit = { oe_geo_bride_fit = yes owner ?= c:GEO }
                        order_by = age_in_days
                        max = 1
                        check_range_bounds = no
                        save_temporary_scope_as = oe_geo_tmp
                        c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_geo_bride_c value = scope:oe_geo_tmp } }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_geo_betrothal ?= 2 country_exists = c:TRE }
        c:TRE = {
            ruler ?= {
                dynasty ?= {
                    ordered_character_in_dynasty = {
                        limit = { oe_geo_bride_fit = yes owner ?= c:TRE }
                        order_by = age_in_days
                        max = 1
                        check_range_bounds = no
                        save_temporary_scope_as = oe_geo_tmp
                        c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_geo_bride_c value = scope:oe_geo_tmp } }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The hidden worker oe_geo.90 (by var:oe_geo_do; 6 = .6 a, the wedding). No debug_log: a player's click reaches
# it (CMDLOG). Everything is tested again, since the pop-up may have waited. When the wedding can no longer be held the
# betrothal is recorded as failed (4).
oe_geo_do_job = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_geo_do ?= 6 oe_geo_bride_ok = yes oe_geo_groom_ok = yes oe_geo_partner_here = yes }
        ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_geo_groom_s }
        var:oe_geo_bride_c = {
            move_country = c:BYZ
            marry_character_ignore_blocks = scope:oe_geo_groom_s
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_geo_betrothal ?= 1 }
            oe_geo_gain = { months = 6 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_geo_dowry years = 10 mode = replace }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_empress value = 1 }
            # the bond with Georgia rises only when the bride is Georgian
            oe_geo_tie_up = { n = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_geo_pontic_bride years = 10 mode = replace }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_empress value = 2 }
        }
        oe_geo_partner_opinion = { m = oe_geo_b_bride }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_geo_do ?= 6 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_geo_betrothal value = 4 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_empress value = 0 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_geo_do } remove_variable = oe_geo_do }
}

# BYZ scope. Pay $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_geo_pay = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -$months$ } }
# BYZ scope. Gain $months$ months of trade and tax income (phases 2-3).
oe_geo_gain = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }
# BYZ scope. Opinions of the empire (phases 2-3): the Papacy; the bride's court (betrothal 1 Georgia, 2 Trebizond).
oe_geo_pap_opinion = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PAP } c:PAP = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } } }
}
oe_geo_partner_opinion = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_betrothal ?= 1 } oe_geo_geo_opinion = { m = $m$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_geo_betrothal ?= 2 } oe_geo_tre_opinion = { m = $m$ } }
}
# BYZ scope. Opinions of the empire ($m$ = the opinion): Georgia; Trebizond.
oe_geo_geo_opinion = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GEO } c:GEO = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } } }
}
oe_geo_tre_opinion = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TRE } c:TRE = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } } }
}
# BYZ scope. The bond with Georgia rises by $n$, 0-5 (later phases and lines read it: .5, N4, L5, the strong routes).
oe_geo_tie_up = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_geo_tie }
        change_variable = { name = oe_geo_tie add = $n$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_geo_tie min = 0 max = 5 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_geo_tie value = $n$ } }
}

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. Run a world step now: the date and the timing (Timur in the Caucasus, the months since t1, Timur's death)
# are ignored; the AI, the preconditions, the wars and the step before it are still checked.
oe_geo_test_m1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_geo_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_m1 } debug_log = "oe_geo test: m1 is already recorded (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_geo_rd_ws')|0]); reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_geo_m1_ok = yes } oe_geo_m1_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_geo test: m1 cannot run now (a player involved, a precondition, a war, or the step before it has not run)" }
}

# BYZ scope. Show an event now: its world step runs first if it can (date and timing ignored); when it cannot, its
# result is recorded for the text only and nothing in the world changes. The wait, the calm and the lock are left out.
oe_geo_test_2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_geo_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_m1 } oe_geo_m1_ok = yes } oe_geo_m1_run = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_geo_wed_done = no }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_wed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_geo test: m1 could not run as a world step; its result was recorded for the text only"
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_geo_ev_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_last value = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_geo.2 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_geo test: .2 cannot be shown (Georgia or Trebizond is gone)" }
}
oe_geo_test_3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_geo_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_t1 } oe_geo_t1_ok = yes } oe_geo_t1_run = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_geo_tbilisi_fell = no }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_geo_tbilisi value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_geo test: t1 could not run as a world step; its result was recorded for the text only"
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_geo_ev_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_3 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_last value = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_geo.3 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_geo test: .3 cannot be shown (Georgia or Trebizond is gone)" }
}

    oe_geo_test_3 = yes
}

    if = { limit = { oe_geo_ev_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_st_6 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_geo_last value = 6 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_geo.6 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_geo test: .6 cannot be shown (the bride's country is gone)" }

# Any scope. A STAND-IN for the Timurids, for throw-away test games only: in a 1337 game they do not exist (vanilla
# flavor_tim.8 founds them from 1360), so t1 and the call of flavor_geo.24 could not be tried at all. As vanilla does
# it, cut down: samarkand becomes a core of TIM, twelve units so that the army-type country counts as existing, then
# the country is built from the core its owner holds. It gets whatever ruler the engine gives it, not Timur.
oe_geo_test_tim = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TIM } debug_log = "oe_geo test: the Timurids exist already" }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:samarkand = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_ai = yes } } }
        location:samarkand = {
            owner = { save_scope_as = oe_geo_tm_from }
            add_core = c:TIM
            while = {
                count = 12
                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_steppe_horse_archers owner = c:TIM }
            }
        }
        scope:oe_geo_tm_from = { create_country_from_cores_in_our_locations = c:TIM }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TIM } debug_log = "oe_geo test: stand-in Timurids built at Samarkand" }
        else = { debug_log = "oe_geo test: the stand-in Timurids were NOT built" }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_geo test: samarkand has no AI owner" }
}
# BYZ scope. Forget this line's state and the world-step records; a tribute this line made is cancelled and its
# modifiers on the empire and on Georgia go (looting, prestige and opinions stay).
oe_geo_test_reset = {
    oe_geo_release = yes
    remove_variable = oe_geo_on
    remove_variable = oe_geo_off
    remove_variable = oe_geo_void
    remove_variable = oe_geo_m
    remove_variable = oe_geo_last
    remove_variable = oe_geo_pick
    remove_variable = oe_geo_dev_no24
    remove_variable = oe_geo_wed_side
    remove_variable = oe_geo_tbilisi_side
    remove_variable = oe_geo_tie
    remove_variable = oe_geo_st_2
    remove_variable = oe_geo_wait_2
    remove_variable = oe_geo_st_3
    remove_variable = oe_geo_wait_3
    remove_variable = oe_geo_st_1
    remove_variable = oe_geo_st_4
    remove_variable = oe_geo_st_5
    remove_variable = oe_geo_st_6
    remove_variable = oe_geo_wait_6
    remove_variable = oe_geo_iviron
    remove_variable = oe_geo_florence
    remove_variable = oe_geo_betrothal
    remove_variable = oe_geo_bride_wait
    remove_variable = oe_geo_bride_c
    remove_variable = oe_geo_do
    remove_variable = oe_geo_ev_off
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_m1
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_m1
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_m2
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_m2
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_t1
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_t1
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_t2
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_t2
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_t3
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_t3
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_t4
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_t4
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_t5
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_t5
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_t6
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_t6
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_k1
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_k1
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_k2
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_k2
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_d1
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_d1
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ws_d2
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_at_d2
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_wed
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_tbilisi
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_king_back
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_shamkor
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_timur_over
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_trib
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_timur_seen
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_wed2
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_west
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_kakheti
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_chalagan
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_tbilisi_1440
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_empress
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_ime
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_bagrat
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_c_bagrat
    remove_global_variable = oe_geo_sme_free
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_pontic_trade } remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_pontic_trade }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_dowry } remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_dowry }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_pontic_bride } remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_pontic_bride }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEO }
        c:GEO = {
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_king_captive } remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_king_captive }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_shamkor_tribute } remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_shamkor_tribute }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_west_secession } remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_west_secession }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_geo_chalagan } remove_country_modifier = oe_geo_chalagan }
        }
    }
}
